g.text: Migration 0031 / full module tables with outgoing references / source 416f0de
FK arrow: child column to referenced key | Solid = required FK; dashed = nullable FK; dotted = view dependency
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UQ = member of unique constraint (possibly composite); ? = nullable column
